title: Concessions Deep Dive
description: An analytical framework for identifying root causes of customer concessions, quantifying financial impact, and recommending targeted interventions to reduce refund rates.
shortDescription: Analytical framework for customer concession reduction

images.alt: Concessions analysis notebook showing trend decomposition
Root cause waterfall chart breaking down concession drivers

problem: Customer concessions were rising quarter-over-quarter with no clear attribution. Leadership needed to understand which operational failures drove the most financial impact.
process: I built a multi-dimensional analysis framework that decomposed concessions by category, root cause, and fulfillment path. Used statistical methods to isolate signal from noise and prioritize interventions.
solution: Delivered a prioritized action plan that identified 3 root causes responsible for 60% of concession spend, leading to targeted process changes and a measurable reduction in refund rates.
